Don’t be a drowsy driver. It takes thousands of lives a year. Thanks to the Sleep Foundation for flagging the risks in Drowsy Driving Prevention Week 2022 #DDPW.

Younger drivers are most likely to drive drowsy. So, #SleepFirst and #DriveAlert. https://t.co/gYSQk5F1Av

Such a pleasure to join @umiamimedicine during the open house of their Rapid Wellness Clinic and Mobile PrEP program units. I recently secured $500K in federal funds to advance their molecular sequencing platform, which will directly advance these and similar initiatives. https://t.co/WGijPt35B6

In #FLA, orange juice means more than just delivering naturally sweet health & wellness to breakfast tables, it's who we are.

On #NationalOJDay, I proudly back our citrus growers and processors to update pasteurized orange juice requirements w/ @USDA & @US_FDA.

#FloridaOJ 💕🍊 https://t.co/eaD7cTaArR

Increasing SNAP work requirements may appeal to some, but consider the consequences. It would leave many vulnerable individuals and families without access to nutrition assistance, exacerbating food insecurity and compromising their well-being. https://t.co/jFm2W47ybx

Agriculture brings jobs & diversity to FLA and puts food and OJ on 🇺🇸’s tables. To prep for the Farm Bill, @VernBuchanan and I led a FL delegation discussion on ag & nutrition needs. I stressed we must protect our No. 2 industry and avoid cuts to child & women food programs. https://t.co/ejrtpEl8hz
If Republicans shut our government down, more than 421K Florida women and children risk losing critical nutrition assistance. https://t.co/8YwiVAXNo9

Thank you @HolyCrossFL for inviting me to share my story about eating healthier and highlighting the importance of food is medicine. @POTUS and @housedemocrats are committed to making nutrition a priority, including ending hunger and reducing diet-related disease by 2030. https://t.co/iQ1pEDMavK

Today I joined the first @Walmart wellness day of 2024! I got a close-up view of their health care services, vision care center, and vaccines, including shingles. This program is a great way to stay on top of your health this winter. Find a store near you: https://t.co/B61WyYnk9W https://t.co/VwPXj0PEHZ

Great to join so many friends at @FloridaHouseDC and discuss how vital the farm bill is to our beautiful state.
From nutrition assistance to agricultural worker support, the farm bill is crucial to our economy and kitchen tables. https://t.co/GHJveqqdib

At @AppropsDems' Agriculture hearing I called out @GovRonDeSantis for his cruel decision to opt out of a summer nutrition program for FL kids.  Nearly half of parents with children in FL's public schools experienced food insecurity last year. DeSantis puts politics over children. https://t.co/ashJLKqVZq

The Biden-Harris administration continues to support veterans by maximizing the benefits they’ve earned, once again putting #PeopleOverPolitics.

No veteran should be left to sleep on the street – @POTUS and @VP are dedicated to achieving that.

Like many others, I had to change my diet & eat healthier after beating breast cancer. Good nutrition is a top priority survivors must incorporate into our daily lives. If I can do it, you can too!

Thx @HolyCrossFL for letting me share my story at the Food is Medicine Symposium. https://t.co/2GFWrgeS9j

Fantastic to see so many friends and neighbors join @yvettecolbourne and I for @CityofMiramar's Mile Run!

Even on a rainy morning, Miramar families came out to exercise and have fun with friends, family and neighbors. 🏃🥇🏃‍♀️ https://t.co/MXsRMcTnhS

House Republicans just voted for the deepest cuts to health care and nutrition assistance ever, all to further enrich the super wealthy. 

I’m proud Democrats fought this One Big Ugly Bill. We’ll keep demanding the lower costs families need. https://t.co/xKv5qfptf5

Just had a powerful and inspiring meeting with local pastors to discuss how we engage our young people and fight these heartless healthcare & nutrition cuts in the just-passed Big Ugly Bill. Together, we’ll empower and defend our community and democracy. https://t.co/Ku7TGUU8lv

Democrats will bring accountability for Elon Musk’s reckless actions with DOGE.

But even he knows, the Big Ugly Bill – that rips health care from millions, explodes our debt, and makes the largest ever cuts to nutrition assistance – is a “disgusting abomination.” https://t.co/SA04zfoUpF

Prices keep rising, but Trump and Republicans only make it worse with tariffs taxes and cuts to nutrition assistance and health care.

Watch as @HouseDemocrats hear from experts and Americans hit the hardest:
https://t.co/vdy9Xc7Ndr

Trump's Big Ugly Bill rips health care from millions, explodes our debt, and makes the largest ever cuts to nutrition assistance.

A recent @USCBO report made it clear: the Big Ugly Bill massively benefits the wealthiest at the expense of working Americans.

Trump just signed a law that steals health care from millions and makes the largest nutrition assistance cuts in history.

He sold out the working class to give tax breaks to the wealthiest Americans. https://t.co/bvUAsVV3cQ

We need to ensure MORE people have affordable health care, food, and housing. Instead, Republicans ripped away health care and nutrition assistance from millions of Americans.

All Republicans did is make life more expensive. https://t.co/ET2KBsb2ie

Republicans weren't satisfied with giving billionaires handouts. They also slashed health and nutrition assistance for millions at home and abroad.

If it doesn't help their billionaire donors or Trump's meme coin, Republicans aren't interested. https://t.co/kL8Nkz2cYo

The critical, quality health services that VA provides to our veterans must be strengthened.

I was proud to join @RepNellie last week to conduct oversight at the Paterson VA clinic and ensure our veterans get the best service we can offer.
https://t.co/BXwg4UDkQ8

.@jwoflorida's Health and Wellness fair was inspiring and empowering. 

As cancer research remains under attack and our healthcare crisis worsens, their work is critical. #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth https://t.co/hy9x2bSkcY

SNAP makes a real difference for our friends and neighbors who need help putting food on the table.

I just lifted up these anxious voices to push Trump to release all emergency nutrition funding so that 3 million Florida kids, seniors and veterans don't go hungry. https://t.co/pqsx3yif1q
